title: Finite order and positive vanishing order on the unit disk
statement: Let A:ℂ→ℂ be holomorphic on D={q:‖q‖<1}. Suppose there exists q∈D with A(q)≠0. Then analyticOrderAt A 0≠⊤. Moreover, if A(0)=0, then 1≤analyticOrderNatAt A 0.
lean_statement: ∀ A : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ A (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1) → (∃ q : ℂ, q ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1 ∧ A q ≠ 0) → analyticOrderAt A 0 ≠ ⊤ ∧ (A 0 = 0 → 1 ≤ analyticOrderNatAt A 0)
